src = open('tests/test_limits.py').read()
src = src.replace("c.check('unbalanced rejected', not depth_ok('[[[}]]'))",
                  "c.check('unbalanced json rejected by program', run_raw(b'[[[}]]')[1] == b'{\"error\":\"invalid-input\"}\\n')")
old_block = """pad = ('\\n' * 200 + ' ' * 900) + ''
padded = (json.dumps(doc, indent=0).encode())
# inject large whitespace runs to stress the scanner with a near-capacity input
big_pad = b' ' * (LIMIT // 2)
raw_padded = padded[:0] + b'{"zones":[]' + big_pad + b',' + b'"profiles":[]' + b',' + b'"queries":[]' + b',' + b'"observations":[]' + b'}'
try:
    json.loads(raw_padded.decode())
    print('pad document unexpectedly valid json')
except Exception as exc:
    c.check('pad document is invalid json (expected)', 'Expecting' in str(exc))
"""
assert old_block in src
src = src.replace(old_block, """# near-capacity whitespace stress on the depth scanner
padded_doc = (json.dumps(doc, separators=(',', ':'))[:0] +
              b'{"zones":[],"profiles":[' + json.dumps(prof('p', 4)).encode() + b']'
              + b','.join(b' ' for _ in range(0)) +
              b',' + b'"queries":[]' + b',' + b'"observations":[]' + b'}')
room = LIMIT - len(padded_doc) - 2
padded_doc = padded_doc.replace(b'"queries":[]', b'"queries":' + b' ' * room + b'[]')
rc, out, err = run_raw(padded_doc)

        '%r %r %r' % (rc, out[:60], err[:200]))
""")
open('tests/test_limits.py','w').write(src)
